idea-plugin.name: Phantom Database Console
idea-plugin.description: Connect to MySQL, PostgreSQL or H2 over JDBC and run SQL from the editor: highlighting for .sql files, Ctrl+Enter to run the statement at the caret, results in a sortable grid, and a lazily loaded schema tree. Drivers come from the project's own dependencies or the local Gradle/Maven cache, so no download is needed. Nothing runs at startup.
